pillarRotationReference._comment: 5-pillar rotation, one week each, repeating every 5 weeks. Week N's Sunday start date determines the pillar for that whole week (Sun-Sat); only advance on a new Sunday, not nightly.

week6.note: cycle repeats every 5 weeks from week1

ctaCadenceRule._comment: Applied to the GLOBAL running post number, never resets.

ctaCadenceRule.divisibleBy3NotAlreadyCaughtBy5: soft CTA - light mention, keep an eye out for Frequency
